description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the AOW_WorkFlow module in SuiteCRM, testing object instantiation, CRUD operations, linked bean handling, and flow processing methods.

classes.name: AOW_WorkFlowTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for the AOW_WorkFlow module, testing constructor, attribute assertions, CRUD operations, linked beans, and flow execution methods.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the test environment, initializes a mock current user, and loads default configuration.

methods.name: testAOW_WorkFlow
methods.description: Tests the instantiation and initial property values of the AOW_WorkFlow bean.

methods.name: testbean_implements
methods.description: Verifies the bean_implements method behavior with various parameter inputs.

methods.name: testmark_delete_related
methods.description: Creates a workflow and condition, then tests if deleting the workflow also deletes related conditions.

methods.name: testsave
methods.description: Tests saving a new workflow and then deleting (mark deleted) it, verifying record existence.

methods.name: testload_flow_beans
methods.description: Executes load_flow_beans method and asserts no exceptions are thrown.

methods.name: testrun_flows
methods.description: Calls run_flows method and asserts it returns true.

methods.name: testrun_flow
methods.description: Tests the run_flow method execution within a try-catch block.

methods.name: testrun_bean_flows
methods.description: Tests run_bean_flows with different bean modules, expecting true each time.

methods.name: testget_flow_beans
methods.description: Checks get_flow_beans method returns a non-zero count for a specified flow module.

methods.name: testbuild_flow_query_join
methods.description: Tests build_flow_custom_query_join and build_flow_relationship_query_join methods with different types.

methods.name: testbuild_flow_query_where
methods.description: Validates build_flow_query_where method's output based on module and attribute settings.

methods.name: testbuild_query_where
methods.description: Incomplete test placeholder for build_query_where with various condition setups.

methods.name: testcheck_valid_bean
methods.description: Verifies that check_valid_bean returns true for a valid bean related to the workflow.

methods.name: testcompare_condition
methods.description: Ensures compare_condition correctly evaluates various operators and operand combinations.

methods.name: testcheck_in_group
methods.description: Checks that check_in_group returns false for non-matching group conditions.

methods.name: testrun_actions
methods.description: Simulates running actions on a bean and tests if processed records are created and can be soft-deleted.
